name: Deskwright
description: Compositor-side helpers for JARVIS on GNOME/Wayland: screenshots, window list/geometry/control, pointer position, clipboard, the Deskwright conversational surface, an activity border, and a session-scoped halt control. The global JARVIS shortcut is configured by GNOME Settings rather than hard-coded in the extension. Independent of (and coexists with) migration-helpers@tristan.local: different UUID, bus name, schema, no shared state.
